lines.text: Why you should never keep all your crypto on one exchange.
On October twenty-ninth, hackers broke into Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange.
Early findings point to one engineer's hacked laptop.
Within about twenty minutes, six point three billion dollars were drained.
WAIT!!! FOLLOW for more stories like this!!!
Anyway. It's the biggest crypto theft ever, about four times the old record.
Experts suspect North Korean hackers, and Binance froze all withdrawals.
